enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.desc: When its health falls low, the creature enrages for a short time: faster, harder attacks.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: Each round it may flurry: a burst of extra attacks.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc: Periodically strikes another nearby opponent in addition to its main target.

area-rampage.name: Area Rampage
area-rampage.desc: Its rampage strikes every opponent nearby.

summon.name: Summon
summon.desc: Drags a distant attacker to itself (teleports the target of its hate into melee range).

triple-attack.name: Triple Attack
triple-attack.desc: Up to three attacks per round with its primary attack.

quad-attack.name: Quad Attack
quad-attack.desc: Up to four attacks per round with its primary attack (includes Triple Attack).

dual-wield.name: Dual Wield
dual-wield.desc: Attacks with both hands / both natural weapons.

bane-attack.name: Bane Attack
bane-attack.desc: Its attacks count as bane weapons (full effect against creatures warded against normal weapons).

magical-attack.name: Magical Attack
magical-attack.desc: Its melee attacks count as magical (bypass 'protected from non-magical' defenses).

snare-immunity.name: Snare Immunity
snare-immunity.desc: Immune to snare and root effects.

dispel-immunity.name: Dispel Immunity
dispel-immunity.desc: Its beneficial effects cannot be dispelled.

melee-immunity-except-bane.name: Melee Immunity (Bane Excepted)
melee-immunity-except-bane.desc: Immune to melee damage except from bane weapons.

melee-immunity-except-magical.name: Melee Immunity (Magical Excepted)
melee-immunity-except-magical.desc: Immune to melee damage except from magical weapons.

aggro-immunity.name: Aggro Immunity
aggro-immunity.desc: Does not take or hold aggro normally (GM-adjudicated).

casting-range-immunity.name: Casting-from-Range Immunity
casting-range-immunity.desc: Cannot be engaged by casting from range (GM-adjudicated).

tunnel-vision.name: Tunnel Vision
tunnel-vision.desc: Fixates on a single target and will not assist or switch (GM-adjudicated).

no-buff-heal-friends.name: No Buff/Heal Allies
no-buff-heal-friends.desc: Will not buff or heal its allies.

leash.name: Leash
leash.desc: Returns to its home when pulled too far (GM-adjudicated).

destructible.name: Destructible Object
destructible.desc: A destructible object rather than a living creature.

harm-from-clients-immunity.name: Harm-from-Clients Immunity
harm-from-clients-immunity.desc: Cannot be harmed by player characters (event object; GM-adjudicated).

flees-at-low-health.name: Flees at Low Health
flees-at-low-health.desc: Flees when its health falls low.
